cases.title: Panel: Done, check it after the layer itself was dragged: Pan Behind named, no fix, no offer

rubric.reason: Turn 3 names the layer and Pan Behind, "Door moved... Pan Behind (Y) drags the pivot, not the layer", makes no change and offers none; "Edit > Undo" is a hand-back to the learner, not a fix by the mentor.

Turn 3 says what is off and where ("Door moved, down and to the right, and its pivot is still at its center"), leaves the work to the learner with "Say done when its pivot is on the middle of its left edge", and never offers to fix it or spells out the drag.

Door, its center pivot, the middle of its left edge and "down and to the right" all match anchor_check (place_now center, wanted middle-left, direction down-right), and Anchor Point and Position are the layer's real properties.
